description: Watchlivo Cloudflare WAF - ordinary abuse protection (bad bots, auth brute force, API flooding)

rules.name: Challenge Likely Automated Traffic On API
rules.description: Challenges low bot-score (likely automated) requests to the API. Verified bots are not affected.

rules.name: Rate Limit Auth Endpoints
rules.description: Limits login/register/oauth attempts per IP to slow down credential stuffing and brute force.

rules.name: Rate Limit General API
rules.description: Protects the origin from request floods.
